summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated in-tarball payload
details: Package declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is obfuscated with hex-scrambled identifiers and property-name lookup tables; it downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then executFileSync's it against math_init.js, a ~727 KB single-line obfuscated bundle shipped at the tarball root (string-array `n7gIxM` with a `WV8StW` array-rotation decoder). math_init.js is unreachable from the package's advertised deployments SDK API (main=dist/cjs/index.js exporting a Deployments class) and is only invoked by the preinstall chain via the downloaded Bun runtime. Using a freshly fetched alternate runtime to execute an obfuscated in-tarball payload at npm install time bypasses Node-based scanners and hands arbitrary code execution to the installer's host. The math_init naming does not match its role as an install-time payload carrier, and neither the obfuscation of setup.mjs nor the alternate-runtime execution is justified by the stated SDK purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
